In pea plants round seed shape is dominant to the wrinkled seed shape and yellow seed color is dominant to green seed color.

i) What will be the phenotype(s) of F1 progeny if you cross true-breeding plants showing Round, Green seeds with a true-breeding Wrinkled, Yellow seeds?

ii) You crossed the F1 progeny to give F2 progeny as per the Mendelian model. Show this cross using a Punnett square.

Analyse the above mode of inheritance and answer the following questions

(i) Why affected children have both unaffected parents? 1 mark

(ii) What is the reason that both male and female are affected? 1 mark

(iii) What is the most probable mode of inheritance? 1 mark

questions.markdown:
In a new species of fruit fly the curly wings phenotype is a mutant and normal wings is wild type. Assume that the study is for flies that are true breeding for the curly wing phenotype and flies are true breeding for normal wings

i) What phenotype is expected to be seen in the F1 generation if the mutant phenotype is dominant? In what proportion would you see these phenotypes?

ii) What phenotype(s) would you expect to see in the F1 generation if the mutant phenotype is recessive? In what proportion would you see these phenotypes?

iii) A homozygous purple flowered short stemmed plant was crossed with a homozygous long stemmed red flower color plant and the F1 phenotypes had purple color with short stem. This F1 generation was crossed with double homozygous recessive plant. Observe following progeny and explain the results for association between the two characters.
Purple flower short stemmed- 52; Purple flower long stem- 47; Red flower short stem- 49; Red flower long stem- 45.

In Hershey and Chase experiment, what kind of organisms were used? What is the reason for selecting $^{32}$P and $^{35}$S labelling in for DNA and protein respectively? A researcher revisited the same experiment with the isotopes of carbon and oxygen. What would be the outcome of this study?

i) Based on the structure and/or chemistry of DNA or RNA give two reasons for why DNA is a better choice to be the stable, heritable genetic material than RNA. (2 marks)

ii) If we heat a DNA molecule which bond will break first? (1 mark)
